g.text: LEZ-001 - Enable / copy a zone template, and a template update (proposal)
select zone_template (no branch filter: system data)
insert branch_zone_rule(branch_id, ...) copied from template v
migration: update zone_template, version v -> v+1,
LINKED zones read the latest version on next use.
The ruleset hash changes, so routes that used the zone become STALE.
COPIED zone flagged: source v < template v+1
view diff, then Acknowledge (or Copy again)
